code:
$report = [PSCustomObject]@{
    Instance      = $instance
    LowDiskDrives = (Test-DbaDiskSpace -SqlInstance $instance |
                      Where-Object PercentFree -lt 15).Name
    StaleBackups  = (Get-DbaLastBackup -SqlInstance $instance |
                      Where-Object { $_.LastBackup -lt (Get-Date).AddHours(-24) }).Database
}
caption: One structured record per server, ready to email, export, or dashboard.
